description: Fetch one Intangible Cultural Heritage element's full record by ich_ref: its description, the list it is inscribed on, the countries that share it, its inscription year, UNESCO concept terms, the World Heritage sites UNESCO links to it, its UNESCO page, and the main image with its caption and copyright credit.

ich_ref.description: The element's ich_ref, from unesco_search_intangible_heritage. A number, a digit string, or the element's ich.unesco.org/en/{RL|USL|Art18}/{ref} page URL.

name: unesco_get_intangible_heritage_element

concepts.description: Primary UNESCO concept terms; empty for the few elements without any.

countries.description: Country display names aligned with country_codes.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries sharing the element, as UNESCO lists them.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `element_not_found`: No record carries this ich_ref. `snapshot_unavailable`: No intangible heritage snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

image.description: Main image with its caption and credit, when UNESCO lists one.

url.description: Main image URL (opens in a browser; not fetched by this server).

inscribed_year.description: Inscription year. Elements dated 2008 were incorporated into the Representative List that year after an earlier proclamation.

list.description: The list the element is inscribed on: Representative List, Urgent Safeguarding List, or Register of Good Safeguarding Practices.

multinational.description: True when more than one country shares the element.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

world_heritage_sites.description: World Heritage sites UNESCO links to the element; empty when none are linked.

id_no.description: World Heritage id_no; pass to unesco_get_site.

name.description: Site name as the element record carries it.

title: Get intangible heritage element
